nodes.name: auth.md
nodes.summary: Pointer doc redirecting the neon skill's own auth questions to the separate neon-auth skill, with fetch URLs for its managed and self-managed setup references.

nodes.name: claimable-neon.md
nodes.summary: Reference for provisioning a temporary, pre-account Neon project via Claimable Neon (CLI and REST), covering creation, claim-code minting, transfer to a human account, and the REST fallback when `neon claim` is unavailable.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a two-actor flow (agent holds a pre-claim identity assertion, human completes the OAuth-style claim/transfer) with explicit CLI-to-REST endpoint mapping.

nodes.name: function-triggers.md
nodes.summary: Reference for declaring branch-scoped Function Triggers (cron schedule or storage-object-created) that POST to a Neon Function, via neon.ts, the CLI, or the MCP/REST fallback.

nodes.name: logs-loki.md
nodes.summary: Reference for querying Neon Functions and Object Storage logs via the CLI, the Loki-compatible read API, and the @neon/sdk TypeScript client's paginated log iterator.

nodes.name: parse-env.md
nodes.summary: Short reference for @neon/env's parseEnv helper, which validates and types environment variables against a neon.ts config, including selecting a required subset.

nodes.name: sdk.md
nodes.summary: One-paragraph stub introducing @neon/sdk, the official fetch-based TypeScript client for the Neon API, and pointing to the logs pagination reference for details.
